data.question:
Inspect sample rows to verify amount, txn_type, and posted_at align with semantic metric definitions.
Profile staging.transactions, then explain its lineage and the metrics it supports
data.sql:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', a.opened_at) AS month_opened,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS new_deposit_accounts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_accounts
FROM core.accounts AS a
WHERE a.account_type IN ('checking', 'savings')
  AND a.opened_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '12 months'
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', a.opened_at)
LIMIT 500;
